2. Explicit instructions telling me exactly where to point my HTTP request (full URL + required headers).

Without those pieces, I can’t issue the correct GET request from here. If you can provide the exact URI pattern (including any authentication tokens or headers), let me know and I’ll gladly make the call for you!
